name: Speaker 8 Ω 0.25 W (15 mm round)
description: Tiny 15 mm round speaker for the smallest cases: speech is understandable at arm's length but noticeably quieter and thinner than 20 or 28 mm speakers; keep the DFPlayer volume at 20 or below (0.25 W). Drive it from an amplifier (DFPlayer SPK_1 / SPK_2), never straight from a board pin.

pins.description: Speaker lead +. To the amplifier output + (DFPlayer SPK_1).
Speaker lead -. To the amplifier output - (DFPlayer SPK_2, which is not ground).

props.label: Impedance
props.description: Coil impedance. The DFPlayer drives 4 or 8 Ω; 8 Ω is quieter but kinder to a battery.

props.label: Rated power
props.description: What the speaker takes continuously before it distorts or burns.

footprint: 15 mm round frame, two solder pads (wires)

bindings.description: Something plays through it (more than 1 mW).
Electrical power into the coil (W, RMS).
RMS voltage across the leads (+ minus -).

mechanical.source: typical 15 mm 8 Ω 0.25 W micro speaker, 3.5 mm deep (toy / greeting-card size)

sourcing.package: 15 mm round, 3.5 mm deep, solder pads
sourcing.generic: Micro speaker 15 mm, 8 Ω, 0.25 W (mylar cone)
